exercises.question: "I will call you tomorrow," he said. He said that he ________ me the following day.
exercises.explanation: In reported speech, 'will' usually changes to 'would' and 'tomorrow' changes to 'the following day'.

exercises.question: "Do you like coffee?" she asked. She asked me if I ________ coffee.
exercises.explanation: Reported yes/no questions use if/whether and normally backshift 'like' to 'liked'.
